items.source: Note that HttpHeaders instances created by the default constructor treat header names in a case-insensitive manner; whereas, instances created with the HttpHeaders(MultiValueMap) constructor — like those instantiated internally by the framework to adapt to existing HTTP headers data structures — guarantee per-header get/set/add operations to be case-insensitive as mandated by the HTTP specification. However, it is not necessarily how entries are actually stored, and this can lead to the reported size() being inflated. Prefer using headerSet() or headerNames() to ensure a case-insensitive view.
items.translation: 注意，由默认构造函数创建的 `HttpHeaders` 实例以不区分大小写的方式处理标头名称；而使用HttpHeaders(MultiValueMap)构造函数创建的实例——例如框架内部用于适配现有 HTTP 标头数据结构的实例——则保证每个标头的 get/set/add 操作符合 HTTP 规范的要求，即不区分大小写。然而，条目实际存储方式未必如此，这可能导致报告的size()值虚高。建议使用headerSet()或headerNames()以确保不区分大小写的视图。

items.source: Changes to the HttpHeaders created by this constructor will write through to the supplied HttpHeaders. If you wish to copy an existing HttpHeaders instance, use copyOf(HttpHeaders) instead.
items.translation: 由该构造函数创建的 `HttpHeaders>` 的更改将写入提供的 `HttpHeaders>`。如果您希望复制现有的 `HttpHeaders>` 实例，请使用 copyOf(HttpHeaders) 代替。

items.source: Applications typically would not set this header directly but rather prepare a MultiValueMap<String, Object>, containing an Object or a Resource for each part, and then pass that to the RestTemplate or WebClient.
items.translation: 应用程序通常不会直接设置此标头，而是准备一个包含每个部分的 Object 或Resource的MultiValueMap<String, Object>，然后将其传递给RestTemplate或WebClient。

items.source: If the supplied HttpHeaders instance is a read-only HttpHeaders wrapper, it will be unwrapped to ensure that the HttpHeaders instance created by this constructor is mutable. Once the writable instance is mutated, the read-only instance is likely to be out of sync and should be discarded.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `HttpHeaders` 实例是只读的HttpHeaders包装器，它将被解包以确保由本构造函数创建的HttpHeaders 实例是可变的。一旦可写实例被修改，只读实例很可能不同步，应予以丢弃。

items.source: If you only need sorted, preferred locales only use getAcceptLanguageAsLocales() or if you need to filter based on a list of supported locales you can pass the returned list to Locale.filter(List, Collection).
items.translation: 如果只需要排序后的首选区域，仅使用getAcceptLanguageAsLocales()；或者如果需要基于支持的区域列表进行过滤，可以将返回的列表传递给Locale.filter(List, Collection)。

items.source: Favor this method over setBasicAuth(String, String) and setBasicAuth(String, String, Charset) if you wish to cache the encoded credentials.
items.translation: 如果希望缓存编码后的凭据，请优先使用此方法，而不是setBasicAuth(String, String)和setBasicAuth(String, String, Charset)。

items.source: The difference between this method and toSingleValueMap() is that this method returns a view of the headers, whereas the latter returns a copy. This method is also susceptible to include multiple casing variants of a given header name, see asMultiValueMap() javadoc.
items.translation: 此方法与toSingleValueMap()的区别在于，前者返回头部的视图，而后者返回副本。此外，此方法还可能包含给定头部名称的大小写变体，请参阅asMultiValueMap()的文档说明。

items.source: Both Iterator.remove() and Map.Entry.setValue(V) are supported and mutate the headers.
items.translation: 同时支持 `Iterator.remove()` 和 `Map.Entry.setValue(V)`，并且会修改标头。

items.source: Both Set.remove(Object) and Set.clear() operations are supported and mutate the headers.
items.translation: 同时支持 `Set.remove(Object)` 和 `Set.clear()` 操作，并且会修改头部。

items.source: If the given port is 0, the host header will only contain the host name.
items.translation: 如果给定的 端口 为 0，则主机标头将仅包含 主机名。

items.source: Note that some backing server headers implementations can store header names in a case-sensitive manner, which will lead to duplicates during iteration in methods like entrySet(), where multiple occurrences of a header name can surface depending on letter casing but each such entry has the full List of values.
